name: TextBox 3
text:
Duplicate CRM records and manual Excel reporting blocked trusted portfolio decisions
• Duplicate records, phantom entries, and manual keying errors in the CRM eliminated a single source of truth, causing double-counting of active leases.
• Leasing managers built their own Excel reports manually, forcing strategic leaders into data entry roles to track basic portfolio performance.
• Operational and financial data could not be correlated, hiding the link between tenant maintenance issues and lease renewal risk.
• Missed renewal windows, delayed vacancy marketing, and slow maintenance response led to revenue leakage and extended vacancies.

name: TextBox 3
text:
Leasing teams shifted from manual data gathering to proactive portfolio management
• Leasing managers now query verified property metrics instantly within Microsoft Teams, eliminating hours spent compiling ad-hoc reports.
• A unified Lease Data Estate eradicated duplicate CRM entries, giving stakeholders confidence that the AI Agent and Power BI dashboards always show identical, validated figures.
• Leadership can now correlate tenant maintenance history with lease renewal probability, enabling intervention before operational issues affect retention or revenue.
• Machine learning forecasts and churn risk scoring allow the leasing team to protect cash flow and optimize occupancy rates before vacancies occur.
